facts.text: I want to ask out Gabby on a second date.
I want the message to include that Gabby is clearly the funniest friend.
I want the tone to be more chill.
I want to include a no-pressure part saying there is no "Ryan or Brian" energy and that a no is more than okay.
I want the message to sound casual rather than weird and formal.
I want to ask for a weekend.
I want the second-date plan to have no drinks.
I want the activities to support Dry February.
I want the activities to be in the city of Pittsburgh.
